description: SO(7) and USp(6) full-letter (phi, psi, f, lambda, derivatives) classical Q-cohomology on SU(3)_R highest weights, complete levels 18, 20, 22 (R-025, T-048). {so7,usp6}_full_j{J}.jsonl: one line per (sector, Y), sector = (2J1, 2J2, 2q1, 2q2, 2q3), fields m (exact hw multiplicity), m_d, r_up (rank of Q into the sector), check (self-check), maxlen; h = m - r_up - r_up(sector below at Y+1). census_j{J}.json: fortuity.full.levels census (totals by Y, (2J1,2J2), D; symmetry; the differing sectors). *_j18_rerun_code.jsonl: level 18 recomputed from code/ on 2026-10-13 (identical m, r_up in all sectors). graviton_*.json(l): weight-space graviton and Coulomb classification (fortuity.full.gravitons.graviton_count) on the Table 1 sectors (gravtest18), the nine differing level-20 sectors (grav_j20, seed 2, coulomb_j20) and the nine feasible level-22 sectors (grav_j22, seed 2); counts are weight-space numbers at the sector's weight (converted to multiplets in R-025 by weight multiplicities). graviton_table1_code.json (+ .log): the Table 1 graviton and Coulomb classification rerun from code/ on 2026-10-13 (scripts/full-letter/so7-usp6/runs/table1_code.py), identical to graviton_gravtest18.json. single_trace_j22_targets.txt: large-N single-trace cohomology of the three level-22 targets (zero), by ranks of the exact Q matrices mod p (2026-10-13; scripts/full-letter/so7-usp6/runs/st_j22_ranks.py).
computed_by: Fortuity collaboration (Claude agent), laptop, 2026-10-08..10 (scans 90 s / 35 min / 50 min per group for levels 18 / 20 / 22; generators 1 h); level-18 rerun 2026-10-13
